label: ადასტურებს {n} გამოცემა
about: Confirmed by N Outlets: an agree scene shows the facts literally in at least N member articles (code counts across all members, N is the smallest count shown, „მინიმუმ N“); outlets are never named by side.
brief: This is the rubric „Confirmed by N Outlets“: what several outlets state alike, and nothing else.
The hook says what happened; the agree scene comes next, written as {"type": "agree", "at": "...", "kicker": "...", "headline": "..."}: code fills its facts and its count.
Its part of the narration says the facts and that at least N outlets state them (in words: მინიმუმ ოთხი გამოცემა).
Never name which outlets, never call an outlet by a side (pro-government, opposition...), never weigh one outlet against another.
